# Orderlya

> Orderlya (Arabic: أوردرليا) is the AI-powered restaurant operating system for MENA —
> "take the order, we run the rest." Customers order over WhatsApp, Instagram or Messenger;
> an AI agent takes and confirms the order in Arabic or English; the POS, kitchen, delivery
> and the numbers all run from one screen. Unlimited orders, zero per-order commission.
> Arabic as a first-class language, EGP-native pricing.

## What it is
- A WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger-native ordering channel for restaurants, with an
  Omnichannel Inbox (included on every plan) and one-tap human takeover.
- AI order-taking (Arabic + English), a live kitchen/POS, delivery dispatch & tracking,
  a web storefront, customer records, cash-on-delivery, loyalty, COGS/inventory,
  demand forecasting, an ask-your-data copilot, and accounting that reconciles.

## Who it is for
- Restaurants across MENA — from a single koshari window to a multi-branch brand:
  delivery-first, dine-in, cloud kitchens, cafés, grills, seafood, bakeries.

## Pricing (EGP / month) — unlimited orders, zero commission
- Orders are ALWAYS unlimited and commission-free on every plan. The monthly number is
  an AI-channel-order allowance — orders received through WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger,
  which still count if you take over the chat yourself; POS/dine-in/phone/aggregator orders never count.
<!-- CATALOG:BEGIN pricing -->
- Start: EGP 850/month — 250 AI-channel orders/month + 25 Enhanced-AI units/month included (single location).
- Run: EGP 1,850/month — 750 AI-channel orders/month + 50 Enhanced-AI units/month included (includes 1 branch; +EGP 1,250/mo per extra branch). Most popular.
- Scale: EGP 2,850/month — includes 1 branch with 1,500 AI-channel orders/branch/month + 100 Enhanced-AI units/month; +EGP 1,250/mo per extra branch (unlimited branches + HQ roll-ups).
- Enhanced-AI units cover AI actions like a demand forecast, an AI win-back message, a menu description, or a supplier-invoice or menu-photo scan. Every plan includes a monthly unit allotment above; if it runs out those AI features pause while ordering keeps working.
- Add-ons (any plan): AI Growth Package EGP 1,250 one-time top-up (adds +500 AI-channel orders & +100 Enhanced-AI units, stacks, no monthly reset); Get Found (SEO) EGP 250/month (includes 1 free refresh/month, then EGP 250 per extra refresh).
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card. Includes 50 AI-channel orders to try the AI; if they're used up the AI pauses while POS/dine-in/walk-in orders keep working (never locked out). No permanent free tier.
- VAT: All prices include VAT. Egypt VAT (14%) is included in every price above — it is not added on top at checkout.
<!-- CATALOG:END pricing -->
- The Omnichannel Inbox is included on every plan. Extra AI capacity via the AI Growth Package one-time top-up.
- A free SEO health meter is included on every plan (from Start up) — a diagnostic that scores how findable your storefront is and lists what to fix. It is not a ranking promise. The active AI enrichment that acts on it is the paid Get Found (SEO) add-on below.

## Plans and add-ons (terminology)
- "Plan" = one of the three cumulative tiers (Start / Run / Scale).
- "Add-on" = an à-la-carte extra you switch on with any plan: the AI Growth Package (EGP 1,250 one-time top-up — adds +500 AI-channel orders & +100 Enhanced-AI units, stacks, no monthly reset), and Get Found (SEO) (EGP 250/month — AI-written search-ready menu pages + a web page per dish; includes 1 free refresh/month, then EGP 250 per extra refresh; the free health meter is already on every plan).
- Money & Stock (inventory + accounting) and Insights (BI reporting) are included in the Scale plan — they are no longer sold as separate add-ons; upgrade to Scale to get them.

## Languages
- Arabic and English, with full right-to-left (RTL) support. Light and dark themes.

## Solutions & feature pages
- [WhatsApp ordering system for Egypt](https://orderlya.com/whatsapp-ordering-egypt): take orders on WhatsApp with an Arabic-speaking AI — no app for customers, no commission on your own channel.
- [AI order-taking](https://orderlya.com/ai-ordering): a conversational AI that takes and confirms orders on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger in Arabic or English, day and night.
- [Commission-free ordering in Egypt](https://orderlya.com/commission-free-egypt): stop paying ~20–30% aggregator commission on your own repeat customers — a flat monthly plan on your own channel.
- [A Foodics alternative for Egypt](https://orderlya.com/compare/foodics-alternative-egypt): an Arabic-first restaurant POS built around WhatsApp AI ordering, priced in EGP, commission-free on your own channel.
- [Kitchen Display System (KDS)](https://orderlya.com/features/kitchen-display-system): every order on the line screen — by station and course, with bump, recall and an all-day view. No paper tickets.
- [Accounting & ETA e-invoicing (preview)](https://orderlya.com/features/accounting-eta): restaurant bookkeeping, Egyptian VAT reporting and settlement reconciliation, with ETA e-invoicing built in and in preview.
- [Restaurant inventory & recipe costing](https://orderlya.com/features/inventory): scan supplier invoices to stock, cost every recipe, auto-86 sold-out dishes, and turn your forecast into prep and par levels.
- [Signals — proactive alerts](https://orderlya.com/features/signals): Orderlya watches your restaurant and alerts you to cash variance, void spikes, quality drops, late orders and low stock.
